name: Swarm
summary: Educational, experimental Python framework for lightweight multi-agent orchestration, now replaced by the OpenAI Agents SDK.
description: Educational Python framework exploring ergonomic, lightweight multi-agent orchestration around two primitives: agents and handoffs. OpenAI marks it as replaced by the OpenAI Agents SDK, which it recommends for production; the repo remains readable with example agents for triage, weather, airline, support bot and personal shopper.
contains: agents and handoffs as the two core primitives
examples: triage, weather, airline, support bot, personal shopper
superseded by the OpenAI Agents SDK
